reason: README Quickstart shows Python CustomVoice inference with a 0.6B public model that can run on CPU in float32.
demo: README Quickstart > Python Package Usage > Custom Voice Generate, using Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice on CPU
goal: Install the qwen-tts package from the repo and get Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice') running on CPU (device_map='cpu', dtype=torch.float32, no flash_attention). Then call generate_custom_voice with an English text, language='English', speaker='Ryan', and write the result to a wav file with soundfile. The wav must contain real synthesized speech.
check: The hidden test runs a short English CustomVoice synthesis on CPU and verifies a valid, non-silent speech wav of plausible duration is written.
